description: This file defines the 'AppFactory' class within the Slim Framework, responsible for creating and configuring 'App' instances with various dependencies such as response, stream, container, and route factories. It includes static methods for setup and factory creation, handling PSR-17 factory detection, and configuration options.

classes.name: AppFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and configuring instances of the Slim App, managing dependencies like response factories, container, routes, and PSR-17 factories.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new App instance with optional dependencies, using defaults or provided arguments.

methods.name: createFromContainer
methods.description: Creates an App instance using a provided PSR container, extracting dependencies if available.

methods.name: determineResponseFactory
methods.description: Detects and returns an appropriate PSR-17 ResponseFactory, with fallback and exception handling.

methods.name: attemptResponseFactoryDecoration
methods.description: Decorates a response factory with Slim's HTTP decorators if enabled and available.

methods.name: setPsr17FactoryProvider
methods.description: Sets the PSR-17 Factory provider to use for factory detection.

methods.name: setResponseFactory
methods.description: Sets a custom ResponseFactory for the AppFactory.

methods.name: setContainer
methods.description: Sets a default container for dependency injection.

methods.name: setSlimHttpDecoratorsAutomaticDetection
methods.description: Enables or disables automatic detection of Slim HTTP decorators.
